dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge follows a deep concave spline, arching significantly inward from the apex to the posterior base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Minimal pixel radius at the fin tip, classified as an acute vertex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Anterior margin displays an approximate 55-degree slant relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical pixel height is approximately 0.8:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Curvature of the forehead fits a moderate radius circle, transitioning smoothly from the blowhole region to the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Tapered pixel projection extending from the melon; length is approximately 0.5 times the vertical height of the melon.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Internal angle of approximately 145 degrees at the coordinate where the melon contour transitions into the rostrum base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A high-luminance, circular pixel cluster is located in the region posterior to the blowhole.
other_distinctive_markers: Translucent internal light-scattering effect throughout the body mass; highly elongated pectoral fin geometry with a rounded tip.
